blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur— Health authorities have raised the alarm anew as dengue infections in Agusan del Sur province continue to surge, breaching 4,000 cases and claiming 22 lives. Data from the Provincial Health Office (PHO) showed a cumulative total of 4,021 cases as of Nov. 16, with 248 new infections in the latest morbidity week. The province’s case fatality rate now stands at 0.55 percent. Epidemiological charts released by the PHO indicate that weekly infections began breaching the epidemic threshold mid-year and have climbed sharply in recent weeks.
